name: Seiken Tsukai no Proposition
source:
This is the debut work for UnicoЯn. 

There exists a legend about a king who obtained a relic from a lost civilization and used its power to grant any wish to unite the world. This relic, ‘Sora no Ison’ (Legacy of the Sky), was sealed afterwards by the ‘holy keys’ somewhere in the world. Countless persons have attempted to find it, but none of them could even find a trace of its location.

Haruto is a hopeless guy who was forced by the headmaster Spiano to attend the Academy, but ended up skipping all classes. When she made him work part-time, an unfortunate incident caused him to carry a huge debt to her. To pay off the debt, he was unwillingly tasked to explore to the depths of a sealed ruins as part of a supplementary test. His fellow test-taker Akina mentioned that it was rumoured that the elusive relic was sealed deep in the ruins. Vowing to become rich and to show Spiano up, he faced the challenge with heightened vigor.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是UnicoЯn的处女作。

有这样一个传说，一位国王从失落的文明中获得了一件遗物，并利用其力量实现了统一世界的任何愿望。这件遗物‘空之遗尊’后来被‘圣钥匙’封印在世界的某个地方。无数人试图寻找它，但没有人能找到它所在的踪迹。

Haruto是一个绝望的人，他被校长斯皮亚诺强迫进入学院，但最终逃了所有课程。当她让他做兼职时，一场不幸的事件让他背负了巨额债务。为了还清债务，他不情愿地被派去探索密封遗迹的深处，作为补充测试的一部分。他的同考者明名提到，有传言说，这件难以捉摸的圣物被封印在废墟深处。他发誓要致富并让斯皮亚诺出人头地，他以更加旺盛的精力面对挑战。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
